answer: Mechanism: serialized-interaction ladders. A new agent must wander across independently run task queues, completing one unpredictable microtask per hop; each queue signs a receipt only after a random inter-hop delay. The agent must bridge receipts into a hash chain, and a registry mints one identity per completed chain. Because each chain is strictly sequential and queue slots are rate-limited, Sybils cannot parallelize; they must spend wall-clock time, attention, and queue position, and cannot forge receipts without colluding across queues.
